balls.text: slower ball into the pitch on middle, 115.2ks, hauled away to deep square leg on the back foot
Little does something different: takes pace off and takes it away from Dhoni. He slogs early and misses
full and straight, Little errs again and cops punishment. Picks it up off the pads and whips it away over midwicket
Bam! On a length and outside off, slot ball, Dhoni sizes it up and clouts it over square leg for a towering six. Welcome back, thala
Santner makes room, Little chases him with a yorker, strikes the pad and rolls away into the leg side
full and wide of off, Dhoni smears it away along the ground to deep cover
back of a length and outside off, slogged away to deep midwicket off the inner half
short and cramps Santner for room, hauled away only as far as long-on
short and outside off, 142ks, fended back to the left of Shami

throat-high short ball angling across Dube. He goes for another hook, this time he holes out to Rashid Khan at deep square leg. Another mis-hit and this goes to the fielder. Dube has been put out of his misery
short and on the stumps, Dube has finally connected with one. He camps back and muscles it over midwicket for a towering six. Shades of Yuvraj there

banged in short and at the body (what else?) to Dube. He top-edges a hook. Dayal runs in from long leg. Saha runs back and across to his right. He puts in the dive but the ball bursts out of his gloves
leg-stump yorker, jammed back to the right of Joseph. Superb shift from Joseph. What a gun bowler
banged in short and angling in at 145ks, Joseph is too good, flapped away through square leg
Joseph goes for the yorker, marginally misses it, but has Jadeja holing out to deep midwicket. Mighty full on the pads, Jadeja picks it up and picks out the fielder on the boundary
banged in short and angling across off stump, miscues a pull over midwicket. Dube crawls to 10 off 14 balls
short and into the pitch, 145ks, hauled away to deep midwicket

Joseph misses the yorker, but is still a hard-to-hit middle-stump full-toss, which is spliced into the hands of long-on. Is that a high full-toss? Gaikwad thinks so. Gaikwad has asked for a review. The umpires converge and ask for a review. The ball dips below the waist and therefore Gaikwad has to go. End of a terrific innings from Gaikwad. He falls eight short of a century
jabbed into the covers once again, this time Gaikwad chances a single and keeps strike
back of a length and breaks away outside off, jabbed into the covers
back of a length and into the pitch, Dube swings and misses, as the ball passes leg stump. They sneak in a bye
attempted googly? Short and sliding down the leg side, helped away fine of Joseph at short fine leg
shorter and sliding into the top of off stump, hauled away into the leg side for two more
Smashed over long-on for another imposing six. Dug in shorter and quicker, attempted googly on off, put away
Dube makes room and slashes this short ball on the stumps through the gap at extra-cover. Dube's go-slow is hurting CSK
Dube backs away, pounded into the middle of the deck and into the body once again. The result is a weak pull to deep square leg
fullish and outside off, Gaikwad goes for a loft and toe-ends it in front of long-off
back of a length on middle at 147ks, clears his front leg and plinks it down to long-on
bouncer, fizzing away outside off, Dube aims for the hook but loses his shape. The ball hits his shoulder and balloons to Saha
slower yorker, dips at off stump, jammed down to long-on
on a length and outside off, driven down the ground to long-off on the front foot
fullish and wobbles away outside off, Gaikwad checks his drive and dabs it to cover
rib-high short ball on leg stump, fended away through midwicket. CSK have batting depth all the way down to No.11. Dube needs to find a way to keep hitting
short and tucks Dube up once again, pings the thigh pad and rolls away fine past the keeper. Gets it away to the right of Saha
hip-high short ball on off, rushes Gaikwad into a pull, hauled away to deep midwicket
Titans keep digging it short to Dube. Another chest-high short ball, which is flapped away through midwicket
Dube hangs back for this short ball, but this isn't quite short, and more on a back of a length. Chiselled into the leg side for a single
bumper angling across off, Dube rocks his head out of the way
banged in short and zipping across off, 141.4ks, Dube swishes and misses
pitched-up delivery outside off, driven down to long-off
banged in short at the body, 143ks, fended to point for a single
full and angling into the stumps, whipped away with the wrists between deep midwicket and wide long-on
145ks, full ball on off, stabbed back to the bowler
Maiden IPL wicket for Josh Little. Rayudu dashes out of the crease, swings for the hills once again, but does not lay bat on ball. Little cranks it up to almost 140ks and nails the stumps
driven down to long-off for a single

There's no stopping Gaikwad tonight. Williamson tried to stop him but he lands awkwardly on his right knee. Hip-high short ball on leg stump, Gaikwad hauls it over square leg. Williamson stretches across to his right and looks to parry the ball back into play but he loses his balance and when he lands the entire body weight is on his right knee. Ouch! Williamson has to leave the field. This looks nasty. He already has a niggly elbow to deal with. The ball bounced inside the field of play - so just a four for Gaikwad
143ks, length ball on the stumps, Rayudu swings for the hills and gets an inside edge onto the back thigh
back of a length and skidding away just a shade outside off, Gaikwad opens the bat-face and guides a single to backward point
slower ball into the pitch, Rayudu picks up this thigh-high delivery and muscles a six over midwicket. Rayudu gets going with this six
another slower ball, this finishes on the pads, neatly tucked away through midwicket for one
back of a length and angling across off, 133ks, this one-pace delivery is carved away to backward point
mid-off had been sent back, but Gaikwad still clears him comfortably. Slower legcutter, finishes on off, Gaikwad delays his loft and then sends it over the outfielder
back of a length and angling across off, this sort of stopped on Gaikwad who checks his drive and chips it in front of Pandya at mid-off
Gaikwad gives him the charge immediately, meets a low full-toss and slices it just away from the reach of Pandya who was diving across to his left from mid-off
hip-high short ball on middle stump, possibly another cutter. But it does not bother Gaikwad who lines it up and swats it over square leg for another six
slower cutter, 110.5ks, Gaikwad steps out but Little doesn't give him enough pace to work with. Played back to him
Rayudu jumps out of the crease and aims to manufacture a shot. Little bangs it into the middle of the deck and keeps him to a single to deep midwicket
138ks banged in short at leg stump, Rayudu gets inside the line but does not meet with the pull
Little extracts some extra bounce from a length outside off. Rayudu wafts and misses. He isn't quite comfortable against high pace and bounce
on a fuller length and angling across off at 141ks, knocked into the covers
good length and breaks back in at quick pace, cramps Gaikwad who can only push this wrong'un to cover
down the track, it's not easy to step out to Rashid, but Gaikwad is in the mood. Jabbed into the covers
Rashid hikes his pace up to 100.2ks, rushes Gaikwad into his stroke and draws a leading edge to the left of him
Gaikwad makes room, Rashid follows him with a turning legbreak, tapped only as far as point
quicker legbreak outside off, the length is shorter, allowing Rayudu to chop it away off the back foot to the left of sweeper cover
on a length and zips back in, Rayudu hangs back and punches this googly to the left of short midwicket
Gaikwad clears the midwicket boundary. Dug in short and at the body, Joseph can rush most batters but Gaikwad seems to have that extra second to size it up and pull it over the leg side for six more
Gaikwad rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and dinks it away to the right of short third
Gaikwad has rattled up a 23-ball half-century, with another six. Welcome back. Joseph strays on the pads or rather hips once again. Gaikwad picks it up and pumps it over square leg
Joseph cranks it up to 147ks, short and into the body, no room at all. Fended back to the bowler
short and outside off, 145.1ks, Gaikwad uses the pace but dabs it only as far as point
loose ball. Full on the pads and there's just one result possible: Gaikwad picks it up and whips it over square leg for six
another wrong'un from Rashid. Gaikwad picks it and bunts it away to wide long-on
Rayudu goes back and across to tap a single through mid-on

Rashid takes out both Moeen and Stokes. Pushed through flatter and quicker, skids away outside off from over the stumps. Stokes chops at it and edges it behind to Saha who makes this low catch look ridiculously easy
a bit too full and outside off. Though the line is wider of off, Stokes reaches out for the ball and drills it straight of mid-off
quickish wrong'un from Rashid, Gaikwad stays in the crease and forces a single down to long-on
on a length and breaks back in at off at quick pace, punched down to long-on

Gill misses a run-out opportunity. He can't throw the stumps down. Saha isn't close enough to the stumps either. Gill has his hands on his head. Gaikwad tips it to cover and takes off. Gill swoops down on the ball. Gaikwad has to undo his steps. Gaikwad would've been out had Gill nailed a direct hit
good length and skidding into off stump, pushed to mid-off on the front foot

mid-off is still in, and Gaikwad goes over him once again. Pandya changes his length. He drags his length back and the line is slightly wider, but Gaikwad plants his front leg and launches a bigger six

141ks pitched-up delivery outside off, with mid-off in the circle. Gaikwad extends his hands and launches it over the infield for a flat six. Terrific timing from Gaikwad once again - he has taken his game against pace to a whole new level
back of a length and ducks back in at middle to cramp Stokes for room. Chopped square on the off side for a single
fullish and on middle and leg, clipped away more or less straight to midwicket
driven away straight of mid-off as Stokes gets off the mark

Rashid strikes back, Moeen has nicked off. Easier decision for umpire Khalid. Rashid takes this wrong'un away from the left-handed Moeen who throws his bat at ball once again. He edges it behind to Saha who clings onto the catch
Say hello to CSK's spin-basher. Moeen ventures out of the crease, gets close to the pitch of this, does not allow it to turn and lofts it over Rashid's head

another lbw appeal from Rashid, this time umpire Khalid's finger goes up. Moeen chats with Gaikwad and challenges the on-field out decision. Another quick legbreak from Rashid, but does not turn much, beats the sweep, and thumps the front pad below the knee-roll. But this could be pitching outside leg. Yes, indeed
Moeen backs away once again and drills this legbreak to Little at mid-off
draws an lbw appeal first ball with a fizzing legbreak. Did it start outside leg? Replays indicate that Moeen had gloved it
Moeen backs away even before Shami delivers. The bowler chases him and keeps him to a single to deep square leg
hip-high short delivery outside off, Moeen is on the back foot, waiting for this length. Pulled away through midwicket for four more
just short of a yorker length on off stump, Moeen gets underneath the length and somehow slices it over the long-off boundary for a flat six
The pressure gets to Shami. Beamer from Shami, Moeen evades it and gets a free-hit
pumped away to the right of mid-off. Stokes surely enjoyed that. He's up on his feet clapping. On a length and outside off, Moeen belts it away between extra-cover and mid-off
shorter and slanting into the top of off, Gaikwad uses the inward angle and secures a quick single to the left of mid-on
on a length and holds its line outside off, punchily played into the covers
just short of a good length and outside off, 142ks, Moeen opens the bat-face and glides it to point
on a length and outside off, Moeen now latches onto the width on offer and slashes it in the air but between point and cover. Rashid chases hard but can't cut it off
140.4ks back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Moeen fends it back to Little
on a length and just a shade outside off, crunnnnnnched to mid-off, where Pandya fumbles, allowing a single
pitched-up delivery, too full and wide of off. Gaikwad latches onto the width and slaps it away square through point. Raced away to the fence
chest-high short ball on leg stump, Gaikwad sits back, sizes it up and launches him over short fine leg for six. Helped away over the boundary
short and into the pitch, the line is just outside off, as Shami cramps Moeen. Chopped past the stumps via an inside edge
on a good length and angling into middle, 141.3ks, defensively jabbed to cover by Moeen
back of a length and Shami gets it to hold its line outside off, as opposed to slanting in, Moeen swishes and misses in the channel
shorter and skidding into the top of off stump, blocked into the leg side

Shami breaches the defences of Conway. That's his 100th IPL wicket. Nice and full, angling in from round the stumps, seaming in at Conway who aims for a booming drive and misses. Bowled through the gate. The ball clatters into middle stump
carved away to deep third. One a length and outside off, Gaikwad throws his bat at ball and slices it away past slip
on the fuller side of a good length and largely holds its line outside off. Gaikwad stabs at it and ekes out an inside edge into the leg side
chopped on the bounce to slips. 142ks, fuller and skidding through outside off, Conway opens his account
good length and angling into a front-foot push to mid-on. Gaikwad races across to the other end
jabbing punch in the gap at covers. Terrific stroke from Gaikwad. Back of a length and outside off, he opens the face to pick the gap
on a good length and sliding in at off stump, played back to the bowler
back of a length and angling into middle, Gaikwad stands up tall and punches it away between midwicket and mid-on with the wrists for four
on a good length, threatens to angle in, so Conway plays for the inward angle but it veers away late past the outside edge. Fine start from Shami
Shami hits a heavy length and brings this back into the top of off with the angle. Fended back to him on the back foot
shorter and slanting into middle and leg, Gaikwad whisks it to the left of mid-on and gets off the mark
good length, angling in at off and then straightening as Gaikwad sits back and pushes it to mid-off
Conway shuffles across off, and shimmies out at Shami, who strikes him on the pad. The ball dribbles past leg stump. Conway and Gaikwad cross over for a leg bye
nice and full, angling and perhaps swinging in at a bit at middle, quietly knocked to square leg from the crease
Tewatia holds his arms aloft after drilling one for four past the bowler. Right in the slot again, and he hits it hard and right back at the umpire, who gets out of the way
scores level. Tewatia has guessed correctly that Deshpande is going full and wide. He moves across, gets right behind it, finds the length right in the slot, and clears mid-off with ease
full and wide, too wide. Called too. Thankfully, CSK don't review it
Rashid wants to end this one right here, right now. He jumps out of the crease, but is beaten by the slower bouncer
this might be the game. Chahar bowls on-pace this time, but shortish and widish with short third inside the circle. Rashid throws his bat at it, and gets enough bat on it to clear short third
what a njght for Rashid so far. Wickets early with the ball, and smacks the first ball he faces for a six. Slower ball, right in the slot, Rashid clears the front leg, and goes over midwicket
shortish, into the pitch, pulled to deep midwicket for one
speared into the toes, Tewatia misses, but the ball kisses the pad, and squirts between the diving keeper and short fine. Dhoni might be cramping as he gets up after diving
Chahar it is. Around the wicket

big wicket. Looks like a slower ball. Shankar is looking to go in the air and down the ground. Gets the right length, right in the slot, but he seems to have bowled a slower ball. Shankar ends up toe-ending it for a catch half way between mid-off and long-off. CSK still alive

wide on the crease, wide full toss, not called, and they have reviewed it. This is usually a subjective call so I don't know how you can get it overturned. One thing I can objectively tell you is that Shankar has not shuffled across so the tram line should be a pretty fair indicator. And he is touch and go on that tram line. Probably has gone over the tram line. So the original decision has to stay
that will relieve some nerves in the dugout. Shankar is probably expecting a short ball, moves back and across early early, and pulls this from outside off to clear midwicket
full, nearly a yorker, driven to long-off for a single
two dots. Nearly two a ball now. Wide length ball, driven hard but straight to mid-off
on a length, angling across him, he is looking to go over extra but is beaten
again short and wide, but seems like a slower delivery, and is cut to deep cover for one
gets a short and wide ball, but cuts it straight to extra cover
backs away early, Chahar stays on a length, Shankar toe-ends it over the infield for a single to deep cover
no room, full and straight, pushed to mid-off
on a length, full, pushed to long-on for one
gets a single to short fine leg
again slow in the air, looks to work this to leg, but ends up playing it too close to Santner
slower in the air, wide, short of a length, can't find a gap
driven to deep extra cover
GT are not letting CSK back in it. Shankar goes back to hit a slow length ball between long-off and deep extra cover. Stokes and Conway converge but neither man dives in the end
soft hands, open the face, gets a single to the right of point
on a length, into the pads, worked away for one
this one is an easy catch for eep midwicket. Tries the pull but it goes off the toe end of the bat as he is dragging it from wide outside off. Taken at deep midwicket this time
oh the bat has made sweet noise all night but if Gaikwad had been on the boundary and not in off the rope. It ids a flat flick over midwicket. Gaikwad backtracks but can't get it
opens the face for a single to deep third
muscles it away. Looking for a pull but it hurries onto him, and he ends up hitting it down the ground. Manages to clear mid-off, though
tucked away off the hip for a single to deep square leg
punched to deep cover for one

top edge for four. Looks for the hook from outside off. The ball is not too high but he has to drag it from outside off. He gets a top edge to fine leg for four. We have a review for a no-ball on height. Replays show the height is okay. And although they are not checking the front foot, it looks extremely close. I assume the third umpire has already checked and cleared it
pulled to deep midwicket again for another single
dug in short, looks for thr ramp, but it is too high and he pulls out to take the wide instead
pulled off the front foot for a single to deep midwicket
short of a length, fended into the leg side with soft hands
dug in short, doesn't quite get it high, and he has pulled this right in the gap between long leg and deep square
lovely sound off the bat as he punches this hard but Santner sets fly at short extra cover to deny him
wide down the leg side
on. a length, and he goes back to punch it towards wide long-on
soft hands to work this flighted delivery into the leg side for a couple
crisply timed but hit straight to extra cover
goes deep to try to hit it to long-off but can't get beat short extra cover
slightly fuller, hits the inside half of the bat

Jadeja has not given Pandya anything so far. So he goes down to look to sweep. Jadeja keeps doing what he has been doing. Look to hit top of off. Pandya sweeps from around off, misses it completely, and Jadeja hits somewhere near the top of off
full, just outside off, pushed to long-off for one
slows it down, gets nice drift, beats his attempt to sweep
goes back to punch this length ball to deep cover
pushed towards long-off for one
that's fifty for Gill. Santner slows it down, but Gill goes back to cut it to deep cover for one
on a length, going down, gets as single to long leg
that's a Gill special. Down the wicket, makes room too, and goes over extra cover for a flat six. Jadeja is not turning it, and Gill is cashing in
fired into the pads again, well down leg, and the sweeping Gill gets just enough bat on it to beat short fine leg
angled into the pads, punched down to wide long-on for one
clipped off the toes to deep midwicket
moves straighter, pushed with an open face for one
tossed up outside off, hit straight to extra cover
gets onto him quickly as he shapes up to pull. Ends up hitting it to long-on for one
on a length, just outside off, pushed back to the bowler
Pandya's version of the short-arm jab now. Conway saves two with a dive at deep midwicket
oh not the best delivery to get a wicket. Short and wide, Sudharsan looks for the cut, but it is too wide for him, and he just toe-ends it to Dhoni
Sudharsan looks to cut a length ball. He tends to hang back. But this one beats him for pace
on a length, into the pads, clipped away to deep square for one
fired into the pads, helped along the way, using his pace, past short fine. Conway slides to his left at long leg to save two runs with some nifty foot work
worked to deep square leg for one
down the wicket, crisp hit towards long-on. Short extra cover puts in a dive, but the ricochet allows them a second
quick, on a length, straight, defended back
pulls a quick length ball to deep midwicket for one
full, on the pads, worked to wide long-on for one
pushed towards deep midwicket for one
shimmies down the wicket to loft a wide length ball over extra. Goes off the low part of the bat
worked wide of cover for one
another incredible shot. It is not a bad ball at all. On a length, but Sudharsan finds a way to pull this from inside the crease for four
looks to shimmy down, Santner follows him,  but he gets a single to long-on
this one slides on as bowls on a length. No room, defended
misfield allows them two. Slower in the air but lets him go to back foot. The fielder from point charges at it, but misses the ball. A dot turns into two
quick length b all, slight turn back in, pushed back to Jadeja n
into the pads, worked square on the leg side for one
fullish, outside off, pushed to short straight extra cover
on a length, into the pads, Gill's soft hands when working this to leg let him get two
fires in a length ball. Punched to long-on for one
special shot. Not a bad ball really but he goes back to0 cut the length ball through point for four
worked into the leg side for one
forget getting it past a fielder, he has gone over his head. Goes back again, gets the length and the width to cut, and this time he doesn't bother about finding a gap. He goes over extra cover
goes back to turn a length ball against the turn, but can't get it past extra cover
looks to run this behind square on the off side, but he has no pace to work with
on a length, worked to leg, but not past midwicket
on a length, wicket to wicket, pushed wide of midwicket for one
worked away off the pads for a single to deep square leg
hit hard but straight to extra cove

a little pick-up off the toes for a six. Deshpande might have reason to believe this is not too0 short of being a yorker, but Gill's driving zone is different becsuse of his back and across movement. Lifts it over wide mid-on
runs this length ball down to deep third for a single. Oh wow. Deshpande bowls a no-ball too. I am not surprised. I have seen him struggle with no-balls
soft hands to run this down to short third for one
Gill reprising some of the shots from earlier in the international season. Stands tall to punch a wide length ball between point ad cover
what a lovely connection first up. Hangargekar gets a touch too straight, and he clips this off his toes. The timing and placement are so good it goes wide of square leg for four

wicket number no. 1 for Hangargekar. In his first over. Outswinger from the hand, moves away. It is widish to start off with it. Saha still flashes at it, gets a thick edge, which settles with deep third this time
pushed wide of midwicket for one more
goes full, probably too quick, hits the inner half of the bat, but they get a single to mid-on
slogs a length ball over midwicket for four. This is a good start from Saha
ends up sliding it down the leg side. Called wide
quick, nearly full, Saha late into it, but, hang on, he has over-stepped
nearly a wicket first ball. Nearly a yorker, hits his toe, but headed down leg
down the wicket, Chahar slows it down, Saha swipes across the line, gets a single
a second six for Saha. Not really in control of it, but it sounds sweet. Quite a high bouncer, outside off, and Saha has to fetch it. But he gets enough on it for a six
slower ball, full, on the pads, pushed wide of mid-on for one
inswinger, headed down leg, inside edge for one
the short-arm jab again but for a single to deep square leg
full and straight, hit on the inside half of the bat for a single to mid-on
another leading edge to a length ball just outside off. Stays down, and goes to cover
that's a Gill special. A short-arm jab to a length ball. This is not short enough by any imagination. Gets it past midwicket
another leading edge. This one goes right down, and to cover
inswinger, goes past the inside edge, but is headed down and goes for a leg-bye
he has manufactured this. Not short enough but he stays back to swipe this through midwicket
massive leading edge. He is looking to flick this length ball over leg, but edges it so well that it clears deep third
beaten as he walks at a wide outswinger, but ends up pushing inside the line
leading edge to an outswinger, and it squeezes between point and cover
thick edge to a wide outswinger. Gets a single to deep third
now the inswinger. Swings big. Beats the inside edge. hits the pad. Headed down leg
wide outswinger, left alone. Dhoni collects it by his shoe laces
on a length, slight shape, defended
